entries.en: Ah, yes! That was the name of the teacher[n]I had a crush on back when I was in[n]elementary school!

entries.speaker: Neighborhood Housewife
entries.en: Sakura-san's single, right? I thought[n]he didn't have any children.

entries.speaker: Shopper
entries.en: By the way, do you eat a lot?
What are you talking about?
Hey, I'm a growing boy.

entries.speaker: Shopper
entries.en: Well, whenever Boss buys food,[n]it's enough to feed three people.

entries.speaker: Shopper
entries.en: If it's just you and him, then you've[n]been eating enough for two, right?[n]You must have quite the appetite.

entries.speaker: Shopper
entries.en: ...What? You're telling me you don't[n]actually eat that much? Maybe it's[n]Boss who eats a lot then...

entries.en: Futaba...? Hmm, nope, don't[n]know anyone like that.

entries.speaker: Delivery Company Man
entries.en: I come to Sakura-san's often to make[n]deliveries, but I've never seen who[n]you're talking about.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, up until now, our biggest lead[n]seems to be...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The chief buys a lot of food, far more[n]than enough for one person living alone.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
